prediction_requirements: Input data must contain the exact model feature names.
Features must be supplied in the model feature order.
Numeric preprocessing must reproduce training-time transformations.
Generation lag and rolling features must use only information available at prediction time.
Future weather features must come from weather information available at forecast issue time.
No future generation observations may be used when generating an operational forecast.
P10/P50/P90 models should be evaluated together.
Conformal calibration should be applied only when compatible calibration artifacts are available.
prediction_contract.important_note: The LightGBM model files alone are not sufficient to reproduce the entire production pipeline; exact feature engineering and issue-time weather preparation must also be reproduced.

reproducibility_warning: Model artifacts, feature order, preprocessing configuration, weather inputs and calibration artifacts must all be aligned for production prediction.

issues_resolved.fix: Objective extracted from model file content. load_error removed.

issues_resolved.root_cause: Production engine list had AC_POWER; models trained with PLANT_ID. One-column mismatch made intersection empty.
issues_resolved.fix: Common features and per-model schemas populated from model file inspection.
